summary.text:
[0-3] Two men walk side-by-side on red track. Left: black tank top with white "KIRKHAM" text and plaid shorts, smiling. Right: pale yellow tank top and dark shorts, smiling. Social media comment, pink text "やってみよー". Gestures: thumbs-up, finger point.
[3-11] Man in black tank walks grass. Blue text: "普通に走っても"→"つまんないからさ"→"1 周目から全力で走ってみる！". Black text "あなたあたま大丈夫そ？？" appears. Later text "どこまでもつか挑戦してみる"→"んふふふ". Background runner in yellow vest appears/disappears.
[11-14] Man sits cross-legged on grass, holding pink packet to mouth. Water bottle on ground. Text: "自分の体重×3~5 倍 (ml) が目安".
[14-21] Man stands/walks track, hands on hips, looking left. White text "いつも以上に緊張中". Pink text "みつかさん 緊張してますねー" appears/disappears. Passes white marker pole.
[21-24] Wide shot start line. Text "スタート地点", Text "ゴッ!". Group sprints across grass towards trees.
